interface.longDescription: Cursourcing combines Cursor and outsourcing. Codex plans with your selected model and can hand well-defined subtasks to Cursor Grok 4.6 xhigh fast, follow execution, and review results. Supports asynchronous tasks, concurrent conversations, follow-ups, and session recovery.
defaultPrompt: Use $cursourcing to plan this task, use Cursor where helpful, and review the results.
